# PeerJS

`peerjs-1.5.5.min.js` is copied without changes from `peerjs@1.5.5/dist/peerjs.min.js` in the official npm package. The dependency is pinned in the root package lock. `peerjs-LICENSE.txt` preserves the package's MIT license.

The browser loads this local bundle only when WebRTC rooms are used; no runtime CDN is required. Default signalling and ICE settings are supplied by PeerJS. See https://peerjs.com/client/faq and https://peerjs.com/server/cloud for service scope and connectivity limitations.
